stakeholders.name: Priya (CTO)
stakeholders.text: p95 is over 300 ms and I have the board demo in an hour. What's the plan?

responses.label: Own it and give an ETA
responses.reply: Thanks. Update me every 15 minutes until it's green.

responses.label: Blame the cloud provider
responses.reply: Customers don't care whose fault it is. Fix it.

responses.label: Buy capacity right now
responses.reply: Approved. Don't make emergency spend a habit.

stakeholders.name: Marcus (Support lead)
stakeholders.text: Ticket volume just tripled — people are getting errors at checkout. What do I tell them?

responses.label: Post an honest status update
responses.reply: Linking it in every reply. That buys us patience.

responses.label: Say it's a user-side issue
responses.reply: Three customers just posted screenshots proving otherwise.

responses.label: Say nothing for now
responses.reply: OK, but silence reads as not knowing.

stakeholders.name: Dana (Lead investor)
stakeholders.text: I'm seeing chatter about outages on social. Is the platform stable enough for the next round?

responses.label: Share the remediation plan
responses.reply: A plan with dates. That's what I needed to hear.

responses.label: Promise it won't happen again
responses.reply: Nobody can promise that. I'd rather hear how you'll detect it sooner.

stakeholders.name: Northwind (Enterprise customer)
stakeholders.text: Our team can't work. Our contract has an SLA — are we getting credits for this?

responses.label: Acknowledge and offer SLA credit
responses.reply: Appreciated. We'll keep our renewal on the table.

responses.label: Acknowledge, credits after review
responses.reply: Fine, but we'll be watching the post-incident review.

responses.label: Deny the SLA was breached
responses.reply: Our monitoring says otherwise. Escalating to our account manager.

stakeholders.name: Omar (Finance)
stakeholders.text: Infrastructure spend is over $1,000 a month now. Is every one of those tiers earning its keep?

responses.label: Walk through the cost per nine
responses.reply: OK — I can defend that to the board.

responses.label: Tell finance it's an engineering call
responses.reply: It's a company call. I'm adding this to the exec agenda.

stakeholders.name: Omar (Finance)
stakeholders.text: We're running at a loss this month. Where can infrastructure spend come down without hurting uptime?

responses.label: Name the over-provisioned tier
responses.reply: Concrete. Let's do it after this week's launch.

responses.label: Freeze all upgrades
responses.reply: Careful — a freeze during an incident is how outages get longer.
